privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro:
Welcome to Qulo ("App", "we", "us", or "our"). Qulo is a question-based dating application developed by Berkant Çalıkuşu, an individual developer based in Istanbul, Turkey.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use Qulo. We are committed to protecting your privacy in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK, Law No. 6698), and other applicable data protection laws.

By creating an account or using Qulo, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
privacyPolicy.dataCollection:
We collect the following categories of personal data:

• Account Information: Email address, password (bcrypt-hashed — we never store plaintext passwords), date of birth (to verify 18+ eligibility), display name, and gender.

• Profile Data: Profile photos, bio text, questions you create (2–10 questions per user), and your answers to other users' questions.

• Location Data: GPS coordinates when you use the Discover feature (to show nearby users) and Passport mode (Premium only, to browse users in other locations). Location is collected only while the app is in use and only with your explicit permission.

• Usage & Analytics Data: Firebase Analytics collects anonymized app usage data (screens viewed, features used, session duration) with a 14-month retention period. Firebase Crashlytics collects crash reports and device diagnostics with a 90-day retention period.

• Transaction Data: In-app purchase history processed through Apple App Store or Google Play via RevenueCat. We do not collect or store payment card details.

• Chat Data: Messages exchanged between matched users, including chat questions and their answers.

• Diamond & Activity Data: Green diamond earnings, purple diamond purchases, power usage (Oracle, Half, Skip, Time Extend, Hint, Skip All), badges, levels, and gameplay statistics.

• Sign-In Identifiers: If you choose to sign in with Google or Apple, we receive an account identifier from that provider and, to the extent you allow it, your name and email address. We never receive your Google or Apple password.

• Chat Media: Photos and voice messages you send inside a conversation. Voice messages require microphone access, which is requested only at the moment you record.

• Advertising & Measurement Data: App events such as app opens, registrations and purchases and — if you allow tracking — your device advertising identifier (IDFA on iOS, Advertising ID on Android). These are used solely to measure the performance of our own advertising campaigns.

• Account Deletion Feedback: If you optionally tell us why you are deleting your account, we store that reason together with your app version, platform and language.
privacyPolicy.dataNotCollected:
We want to be transparent about what we do not collect:

• Phone number or phone contacts
• Browsing history outside of Qulo
• Biometric data (fingerprint, face scan)
• Government-issued ID or identity documents
• Financial information or credit card numbers
• Data from other apps on your device
privacyPolicy.usageTitle: How We Use Your Data & Legal Basis
privacyPolicy.usage:
We process your personal data for the following purposes:

• To provide the service (Legal basis: Contract performance) — Creating and maintaining your account, displaying your profile and questions to other users, facilitating matches and conversations.

• To enable discovery (Legal basis: Consent) — Using your location to show nearby users and enable the Passport feature.

• To process transactions (Legal basis: Contract performance) — Managing diamond economy, processing in-app purchases through RevenueCat, and maintaining subscription status.

• To improve the app (Legal basis: Legitimate interest) — Analyzing anonymized usage patterns through Firebase Analytics, fixing bugs using crash reports from Crashlytics.

• To send notifications (Legal basis: Consent) — Sending push notifications about new matches, messages, and app updates via Firebase Cloud Messaging. You can disable notifications at any time in your device settings.

• To ensure safety (Legal basis: Legitimate interest) — Detecting and preventing fraud, abuse, and violations of our Terms of Service.

• To measure our advertising (Legal basis: Consent) — Sending app events such as app opens, registrations and purchases to Meta and our measurement tools so we can understand which campaigns bring new users. On iOS your advertising identifier is used only if you allow tracking in the App Tracking Transparency prompt; if you decline, measurement is carried out only in an aggregated, non-identifying form. You can change this at any time in your device settings.
privacyPolicy.sharing:
We do not sell your personal data. We share data with the following third-party service providers, solely for the purposes described:

• Supabase (Database hosting) — Stores your account data, profile, messages, and app data. Supabase servers are located in the EU. Privacy policy: supabase.com/privacy

• Firebase / Google (Analytics, Crashlytics, Push Notifications) — Processes anonymized analytics data, crash reports, and delivers push notifications. Privacy policy: firebase.google.com/support/privacy

• RevenueCat (In-app purchases) — Manages subscription and purchase validation for Apple App Store and Google Play. Privacy policy: revenuecat.com/privacy

• Apple App Store / Google Play (Payment processing) — Processes payments for subscriptions and diamond purchases. Data handling is subject to Apple's and Google's respective privacy policies.

• Meta Platforms, Inc. (Advertising measurement) — Receives app events (app open, registration, purchase) and, where you have allowed tracking, your device advertising identifier, so that we can measure our advertising campaigns. Purchase events are forwarded through RevenueCat. Privacy policy: facebook.com/privacy/policy

• Google and Apple (Sign-in providers) — If you choose to sign in with Google or Apple, these providers process your sign-in request and share a limited account identifier with us. Their handling of that data is subject to their own privacy policies.

All third-party providers are contractually obligated to protect your data and process it only for the specified purposes.
privacyPolicy.retention:
We retain your data for the following periods:

• Account data: Until you delete your account.
• Chat messages: Until you delete your account or the conversation is deleted by both parties.
• Firebase Analytics data: 14 months (Google's default retention).
• Firebase Crashlytics data: 90 days.
• Transaction records: As required by applicable tax and commercial law (up to 10 years under Turkish Commercial Code).

When you delete your account, your personal data is removed from our database immediately. Data held by third-party services (Firebase, RevenueCat) is subject to their respective retention policies.
privacyPolicy.security:
We take data security seriously and implement the following measures:

• All data is transmitted over HTTPS/TLS encryption.
• Passwords are hashed using bcrypt — we never store or have access to plaintext passwords.
• Authentication uses secure JWT tokens (access + refresh token pattern).
• Database access is restricted to authenticated and authorized requests.
• Our database is hosted on Supabase infrastructure within the EU.

While we implement industry-standard security measures, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security of your data.
privacyPolicy.rights:
Under GDPR and KVKK, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

• Right of access — Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
• Right to rectification — Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
• Right to erasure — Request deletion of your personal data (see Account Deletion below).
• Right to restrict processing — Request that we limit how we use your data.
• Right to data portability — Request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
• Right to object — Object to processing based on legitimate interests.
• Right to withdraw consent — Withdraw consent at any time (e.g., location permissions, push notifications).

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at info@socrepho.com. We will respond within 30 days.
privacyPolicy.deletion:
You can delete your account at any time from the app settings. When you delete your account:

• Your profile, questions, answers, matches, and chat messages are permanently deleted from our Supabase database immediately.
• Your account cannot be recovered after deletion.
• Data held by third-party services (Firebase, RevenueCat) will be deleted according to their respective data retention policies.
• Active subscriptions must be cancelled separately through Apple App Store or Google Play. Deleting your Qulo account does not automatically cancel your subscription billing.
privacyPolicy.children:
Qulo is strictly for users aged 18 and older. We verify age through date of birth during registration. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18.

If we discover that we have collected data from a user under 18, we will delete their account and all associated data immediately. If you believe a minor is using Qulo, please contact us at info@socrepho.com.
privacyPolicy.location:
Qulo uses your device's GPS to provide location-based features:

• Discover: Shows users near your current location. Location is collected only while the app is actively in use (foreground only).
• Passport Mode (Premium only): Allows you to browse users in a different city or country.

Location permission is requested explicitly through your device's permission system. You can revoke location access at any time through your device settings. Without location permission, the Discover feature will not function, but other app features remain available.

We do not track your location in the background or maintain a location history.
privacyPolicy.cookies:
The Qulo website (quloapp.com) is a static informational site and does not use cookies or tracking technologies.

The Qulo mobile app does not use cookies, but it does use device identifiers:

• Firebase Analytics uses device identifiers for anonymised usage analytics.
• The Meta SDK uses app events and, where permitted, your device advertising identifier to measure our advertising campaigns.

On iOS we ask for your permission through the App Tracking Transparency prompt before your advertising identifier is used for tracking. If you decline, measurement continues only in an aggregated, non-identifying form. On Android you can reset or delete your Advertising ID at any time in your device's privacy settings, and you can opt out of analytics through your device's advertising settings.
privacyPolicy.changes:
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make significant changes, we will notify you through:

• An in-app notification.
• An update to the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.

Your continued use of Qulo after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
privacyPolicy.kvkk:
Under Article 11 of the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK No. 6698), you have the following rights:

• Learn whether your personal data is being processed
• Request information about processing if it has been processed
• Learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used accordingly
• Know the third parties to whom your data is transferred domestically or abroad
• Request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data
• Request deletion or destruction under KVKK Article 7
• Request notification of correction/deletion to third parties
• Object to a result arising against you through automated analysis
• Claim compensation for damages caused by unlawful processing

For inquiries: info@socrepho.com
privacyPolicy.kvkkRights:
Data Controller: Berkant Çalıkuşu
Address: Istanbul, Turkey
Email: info@socrepho.com

You may submit your requests to the email address above. Your requests will be processed free of charge within 30 days at the latest. If the process requires additional costs, fees may be charged based on the tariff determined by the KVKK Board.
privacyPolicy.contact:
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your data rights, contact us:

Data Controller: Berkant Çalıkuşu
Email: info@socrepho.com
Address: Istanbul/Beyoglu, Turkey
Website: quloapp.com

For KVKK-related requests, you may also submit a formal application via registered mail or through the e-government (e-Devlet) system as prescribed by the Turkish Personal Data Protection Authority (KVKK).

communityGuidelines.title: Community Guidelines
communityGuidelines.intro:
Qulo works because people answer each other's questions honestly. That only happens when the app feels safe. These guidelines explain what we expect from everyone on Qulo, what is not allowed, and what happens when someone crosses the line.

They apply everywhere in the app: your profile, your photos, the questions you write, the answers you give and every message you send. Breaking them can cost you your account.
communityGuidelines.respect:
Everyone on Qulo is a real person.

• Treat others the way you would in person. Disagreement is fine; contempt is not.
• No harassment, bullying, threats or intimidation — including repeated unwanted messages after someone stops replying.
• No hate speech or slurs targeting race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, gender, gender identity or sexual orientation.
• No unsolicited sexual messages. Someone matching with you is not consent to sexual content.
• If someone unmatches or blocks you, that is their answer. Do not create a new account to reach them.
communityGuidelines.authenticity:
• You must be 18 or older to use Qulo. Accounts belonging to minors are removed.
• Use recent photos of yourself. No photos of other people, celebrities, stock images, or images altered so heavily that they misrepresent how you look.
• One account per person. Do not impersonate anyone, and do not use someone else's account.
• Do not misrepresent your age, name or intentions.
• No accounts run on behalf of a business, brand or service.
communityGuidelines.content:
The following is removed and can end your account immediately:

• Nudity or sexually explicit content in profile photos, questions, answers or chat.
• Any content that sexualises, endangers or exploits minors. We have zero tolerance here — see our Child Safety Standards.
• Violence, threats of violence, encouragement of self-harm, or content glorifying either.
• Promotion of illegal activity, weapons or drugs.
• Prostitution, escort services, trafficking, or any exchange of sexual services.
• Spam, advertising, affiliate links, or recruiting for other platforms and services.
• Requests for money, investment offers, cryptocurrency pitches, or links to payment pages.
communityGuidelines.questions:
Questions are the heart of Qulo, so they are held to the same standard as everything else.

• Do not use questions to collect personal data — phone numbers, home addresses, workplace details or financial information.
• Do not use questions or answers to advertise, to move people off the platform, or to spread misinformation.
• Keep your questions answerable and honest. Questions written so that nobody can pass, or designed to humiliate whoever answers, are not what this app is for.
• Offensive, discriminatory or sexually explicit questions are removed like any other content.
communityGuidelines.reporting:
Every profile and every conversation has block and report controls.

• Block removes the person from your matches immediately. They can no longer see your profile or contact you, and you will not see them again.
• Report sends the profile or conversation to us for review, together with the reason you select. Reports are confidential — the reported person is not told who reported them.
• Reports involving a suspected minor, threats, or sexual exploitation are prioritised.

If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services first, then report to us.
communityGuidelines.enforcementTitle: 6. What Happens If You Break the Rules
communityGuidelines.enforcement:
Depending on how serious the breach is, we may:

• Remove the content — a photo, a question, a message.
• Restrict features on your account.
• Suspend or permanently terminate your account.

Serious breaches — child sexual exploitation, threats of violence, scams, non-consensual intimate images — result in immediate permanent removal without warning. Diamonds and remaining subscription time are forfeited when an account is terminated for a breach, and an active subscription must still be cancelled through the App Store or Google Play.

If you believe your account was removed by mistake, write to info@socrepho.com.
communityGuidelines.contact:
Questions about these guidelines, or something you need to report from outside the app:

Email: info@socrepho.com
Website: quloapp.com

safetyTips.title: Safety Tips
safetyTips.intro:
Most people on Qulo are exactly who they say they are. A few are not. The habits below are what keep that difference from costing you anything.

We do not run background checks on our users, so please read this before you meet anyone from the app.
safetyTips.online:
• Keep the conversation inside Qulo until you trust the person. Moving to another app early removes the safety tools you have here.
• Be careful with anyone who pushes hard to switch to WhatsApp, Telegram or email within the first few messages.
• Do not share your home address, workplace, daily routine, identity documents or financial details.
• Watch for stories that never quite fit: a job abroad, a camera that never works, a reason they can never video call.
• Search their photos. A reverse image search often reveals whether a picture belongs to someone else.
safetyTips.scams:
This is the single most common way people are hurt on dating apps.

• Never send money, gift cards or cryptocurrency to someone you met online — no matter how convincing the emergency sounds.
• Ignore investment advice, trading platforms and "guaranteed return" opportunities from matches. That is a scam pattern, not a coincidence.
• Do not open links to payment pages, verification sites or "safety check" services that someone sends you. Qulo will never ask you to verify yourself on an external site.
• Be careful with intimate photos. Once sent, they can be used to extort you. If that happens, do not pay — report it to us and to your local authorities.
safetyTips.meeting:
• Meet in a public place the first few times, and stay in public.
• Tell a friend or a family member where you are going, who you are meeting and when you expect to be back. Share your live location if you can.
• Arrange your own transport there and back. Do not be picked up from home, and do not let someone take you somewhere you did not agree to.
• Keep control of your drink and stay sober enough to make decisions.
• Keep your phone charged.
• If something feels wrong, leave. You do not owe anyone an explanation.
safetyTips.privacy:
• Photos give away more than you think — house numbers, street signs, workplace badges, school uniforms, car plates.
• Your username on other platforms can lead back to your full name. Consider using a different one here.
• Be careful when someone asks a lot of specific questions about where you live, where you work, or how you spend your evenings.
• Nothing in your profile or your questions should be information you would not want a stranger to hold.
safetyTips.toolsTitle: 5. The Tools You Have in the App
safetyTips.tools:
• Block: removes the person from your matches immediately and stops contact in both directions.
• Report: sends the profile or the conversation to us with the reason you choose. It is confidential.
• Both are available on every profile and inside every conversation.

Please report behaviour even when you have already blocked it. Blocking protects you; reporting protects the next person.
safetyTips.emergency:
• If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services first.
• If you have been assaulted, harassed, threatened or defrauded, report it to your local authorities — and then to us, so that we can act on the account.
• Keep evidence: screenshots, usernames, message times, payment records.

We cooperate with law enforcement requests and preserve data related to confirmed violations as required by law.

You can reach us at info@socrepho.com.
